sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 260. Deal magic damage (Time) 5 times that penetrates damage reduction and damage reflection effects with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Lethargy for 40 seconds with a success value of 100.
-Target: yourself. Applies Barracks for 60 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] increases critical hit chance by 100%; [Special] increases physical/magic attack Ability success value by 40; [Special] reduces cooldown time by 50%. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Star Inhibitor (prevents star Unison Attacks and star Great Spirit Unison Attacks from activating, increases cooldown by 30%, and disables Unison gauge filling from Ability, Unison, and Skill effects (Unison gauge fill from taking damage or using Abilities remains unaffected)) to the enemy Field for 90 seconds.
Time elemental defense boosted by 200 when equipped in the Main Slot.
